note: Chapter XVII: Seward made clean-shaven to match his portrait.

beats.text: Remove the beard and moustache from the doctor (the man in the shirt-sleeves and waistcoat), so that his chin, jaw and upper lip are bare and clean-shaven, painted in the same light.
